notes: Setup wizard page: “Do one step from the Setup wizard again” – Get free keys for external data sources, Add licence key (links the software to your original purchase), Check everything (diagnostics)
Setup wizard page: you can run the full wizard to change an existing configuration – a new button runs it on this dashboard

Run on a dashboard that’s already set up, the wizard first asks: change the existing set-up, or clear all the settings and start again – which first saves a backup copy of your Google Sheet in your Google Drive (your licence key and access code are kept, so everything stays connected)
